name: Sandesh Local Mail Testing Environment
free_limit: Apache-2.0-licensed local/self-hosted email development environment with SMTP, IMAP, POP3, web console, HTTP API, diagnostics, fault injection, and message replay; no vendor-imposed software quota or expiry.
watch_out: Development/testing mail environment, not a hosted email sending service or production mail provider. Run your own binary/container and provide local disk, compute and networking. Restrict exposed mail/API ports, protect stored test messages and credentials; DKIM/SPF/DMARC are parsed for diagnostics, not cryptographically verified. Version 0.3.0; production suitability not independently tested.
